about_text.value: A doctrine-aware Kalam/Qadi examination storyworld generated from compact research stimulus cards and a bounded Qwen 9B design packet. Yusuf Lin must adjudicate live cases between Mu'tazili justice/agency and Ash'ari power/attributes without turning doctrine into slogans.

authored_properties.description: How strongly the ruling preserves moral responsibility and divine justice.
How strongly the ruling preserves divine omnipotence while locating human acquisition.
How carefully the ruling handles divine attributes without crude anthropomorphism or emptying scripture.
How carefully the ruling distinguishes created utterance/ink from divine speech or meaning.
How stable the school, court, and market remain after the ruling.

text_script.value: Yusuf Lin enters the examination hall at sunrise. On the left wall, Qadi Nizam has written justice before power; on the right, Shaykha Baraka has written power before every cause. text_script.value: Yusuf names attributes without image, justice without rivalry, created signs without contempt, and eternal speech without possession. The final verdict is not a theory of God. It is a discipline for judges who must speak without pretending to contain what they name.
